instance-events/bad-instance-id.json.rule: instance id is i- plus 16 Base32 characters

instance-events/unknown-type.json.rule: type must be in the catalogue

instance-events/unknown-source.json.rule: source is one of the seven values

instance-events/source-not-allowed-for-t.rule: each type has its own allowed source

instance-events/unknown-session-kind.jso.rule: session_kind is one of four values

instance-events/extra-envelope-field-eve.rule: the catalogue event_id is dropped (decision 1); no extra fields

instance-events/extra-envelope-field-act.rule: actor_role is not part of the wire event

instance-events/missing-user-id.json.rule: user_id is required, null when none

instance-events/user-id-number.json.rule: user_id is a string or null

instance-events/missing-data-field.json.rule: every required data field is present

instance-events/flag-value-in-route.json.rule: a string holding VM{ is rejected in every data field

instance-events/flag-value-in-evidence-b.rule: a flag-shaped value never travels, not even in evidence

instance-events/evidence-body-too-long.j.rule: evidence body is at most 8192 characters

instance-events/evidence-missing-challen.rule: evidence.capture needs the challenge key in the envelope

instance-events/flag-seen-bad-kind.json.rule: kind is real, decoy or foreign

instance-events/flag-seen-uppercase-hash.rule: the digest is 64 lowercase hex characters

instance-events/flag-seen-foreign-with-c.rule: kind foreign must not name a challenge

instance-events/flag-seen-raw-candidate..rule: the candidate value is never a field, only its hash

instance-events/giftcard-bad-result.json.rule: result is one of three values

instance-events/auth-attempt-bad-route.j.rule: route is web, legacy or reset_confirm

instance-events/importer-bad-url-class.j.rule: url_class is one of six values

instance-events/kyc-bad-outcome.json.rule: outcome is one of three values

instance-events/flags-injected-from-shop.rule: only the orchestrator side writes it

instance-events/fault-bad-detail-code.js.rule: detail_code looks like an error code

instance-events/flag-value-lowercase.jso.rule: the flag-shaped check ignores letter case (best effort, FR-FLG-02 owns the real rule)

instance-events/flag-value-url-encoded.j.rule: an encoded brace after VM is rejected too

instance-events/session-kind-internal-fr.rule: internal is only for the sources import, orchestrator and platform
internal is only for the sources import, orchestrator and platform

instance-events/flag-seen-challenge-key-.rule: envelope and data challenge_key must not differ (checked in code, not by the schema)

posted/source-sidecar-refused.json.rule: the sidecar refuses source sidecar from the shop path

posted/source-orchestrator-refused.json.rule: orchestrator events are not posted by the shop

posted/shop-posts-proxy-request.json.rule: proxy.request is the sidecar's own type

posted/unknown-type.json.rule: type must be in the catalogue

posted/includes-instance-id.json.rule: the sidecar adds instance_id; the poster must not send it

posted/includes-seq.json.rule: the sidecar adds seq; the poster must not send it

posted/evidence-body-over-2-kib.json.rule: a posted evidence body is at most 2 KiB

posted/flag-value-in-data.json.rule: no flag-shaped value in posted data
